# `dns` check

Resolve a hostname, optionally via a specific DNS server, and check the addresses.

```yaml
checks:
  example:
    type: dns
    host: api.example.com
    server: 1.1.1.1
    expect:
      addresses: [203.0.113.10]
```

## Keys

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `host` **(required)** | string |  | Hostname to resolve. |
| `server` | string |  | DNS server to query, ip or ip:port (default: the system resolver). |
| `expect` | mapping |  | What counts as healthy. |
| `expect.addresses` | list of string |  | Addresses that must all be in the answer. |
| `expect.latency` | {warn, fail} duration |  | Resolution time limits. Triggers when the value is above the threshold. |

Every check also accepts the [common keys](../config.md#common-check-keys).

One-liner: `medic check dns <host> [--set key=value ...]`
